android.desc:
Google Wallet is the safe, fast, and smart way to access your credit cards, debit cards, transit passes, tickets, digital IDs, and more wherever you are—on the go, online, and across Google.

Breeze through checkout on sites, in apps, or in-store wherever contactless payments or Google Pay (GPay) are accepted. 

Google Wallet keeps what matters to you in one secure place with built-in, industry-leading privacy and security.

Safer than swiping your debit card or credit card
• When you tap to pay with your Android device, Google Pay (GPay) protects your card information by sharing a unique virtual card number with the store—not your actual card number.
• Tap to pay is fast and easy. Just ensure NFC is enabled in your settings, unlock your phone, hold it near the terminal, and wait for the check mark.

Easily use your loyalty benefits
• Keep loyalty cards and gift cards organized and accessible, so you won’t miss a chance to earn or redeem rewards.

View your receipts in one place
• View receipts from online and in-store transactions right in your digital wallet.

Travel with confidence
• Add your airline boarding pass and get real-time updates, like gate changes and departure times for your flight. 
• Store your transit pass in Google Wallet, and pay your fare with just a tap.

Keep event passes handy
• Add your event, concert, and sports tickets to Wallet for easy access. Just open Wallet and show your ticket when entering the event.
• Google Wallet automatically updates your ticket with the latest event information, so you don’t miss a beat.

Speed through online checkout
• Use the GPay button or autofill in Chrome to quickly access credit cards and debit cards saved to your Google Wallet to make online purchases.

Track your online orders
• Link Google Wallet to Gmail to view the status and expected delivery date for your orders – all in one place. (US only)

Manage your digital IDs
• Get quick, reliable access to digital versions of your driver’s license, student ID, and more.

Security and privacy you can count on
• Google Wallet features industry-leading security built right into your Android phone, including 2-Step Verification, Find My Phone, and remote data erase. 
• You choose the info you share between Google products, so you can better control your digital footprint.

Google Wallet is available on all Android phones (Pie 9.0+), Wear OS and Google Fitbit devices.
Not all features are available for supervised

quotes.text:
Google Pay ( https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.google.android.apps.walletnfcrel ) can store my Tate and National Trust membership cards, my EU COVID passport (proof of vaccination and booster), as well as boarding passes. And it's smart enough to expire out cards from the pass as expired memberships or flights that have flown.

Anything that can be represented in a barcode or QR code can be stored in it. Which of course turns out to be a lot of things, payments are just one part of it.

Edit: added link, but it's preinstalled on most modern Android devices.

Looks like google wallet is a not-so-well-liked app:
